_doc: FLOCK verification thresholds and weights. Every number the checks / fusion use lives here (docs/checks.md explains each). JSON, not YAML: no extra dependency on the demo laptop.

kinematics._note: Plausible motion is weak evidence (a careful ghost also moves plausibly); impossible motion is strong.

tcas._note: TCAS range is accurate (round-trip timing); TCAS bearing is poor (several degrees, worse near the wingtips), hence the wide bearing tolerance. Values are our estimates, not from a TCAS MOPS - see docs/limitations.md.
